newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India ONGC yr-on-yr crude output ninth month fall.
newsitem.headline: India ONGC yr-on-yr crude output ninth month fall.

text.p: India's state Oil and Natural Gas Corp Ltd's monthly crude oil production registered its ninth consecutive year-on-year fall in December, a company official said on Tuesday.
The official said the crude output from main oil producer ONGC in December was 1.81 million tonnes compared to 1.89 million tonnes a year ago.
Total production in the first nine months of the fiscal year April 1996-March 1997 was 20.071 million tonnes and has lagged by around two million tonnes the same period in the last fiscal year.
"It will continue to be lower than last year's production," the official projected for the rest of the year.
The main cause is the continuing decline in output at the country's largest hydrocarbon producing area, the Bombay High Basin.
While December's output from Bombay High rose to 1.69 million tonnes, a rise of nearly 50,000 tonnes from November, it was a drop of 170,000 tonnes from the same period in the previous year.
In comparison, ONGC has had more success in boosting its gas production.

Natural gas production from the Basin, its main gas producing area, in December registered a monthly rise to 1.1652 trillion cubic metres from 1.1269 trillion cubic metres and a year-on-year increment from 1.1468 trillion cubic metres.
Liquid petroleum gas (LPG) production at 98,800 tonnes was up from 93,020 tonnes in November and from 98.67 tonnes year-on-year.
